title.zh: 禁止特权工作负载（privileged/hostPID/hostIPC/hostNetwork）

tuning.zh: 先以 monitor（Audit）观察 7 天并列出命中清单；GPU Operator/NVIDIA 驱动与 SR-IOV device plugin DaemonSet 移入例外命名空间并加镜像白名单后，再切换 Enforce；例外通道任何新增条目需二次审计
tuning.en: Run in monitor (Audit) for 7 days and review hits; move GPU operator/driver and SR-IOV device plugin DaemonSets into an exception namespace with an image allowlist before switching to Enforce; any new exception entry requires a second review

title.zh: 禁止敏感 hostPath 卷（容器运行时 socket / 宿主系统路径）
title.en: Deny sensitive hostPath volumes (runtime sockets / host system paths)

tuning.zh: GPU 直挂（/dev/nvidia*）与日志只读挂载可按命名空间放行；前缀表按客户基线裁剪，建议保留 '/' 与运行时 socket 前缀为硬阻断
tuning.en: Allow GPU device mounts (/dev/nvidia*) and read-only log mounts per namespace; trim the prefix list to the customer baseline, but keep '/' and runtime socket prefixes hard-denied

title.zh: 禁用 ServiceAccount 令牌自动挂载

tuning.zh: 确需令牌的工作负载（operator、Fluentd 采集器）放入白名单命名空间并在 SA 级显式开启；其余一律 false；配合 operator SA 约束（见 RBAC 收敛清单）
tuning.en: Workloads that truly need the token (operators, log agents) go to an allowlisted namespace and opt in at the SA level; everything else defaults to false; pairs with operator SA constraints in the RBAC convergence list

title.zh: RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding 创建告警（cluster-admin 指向硬阻断）
title.en: Alert on RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding creation (hard block when pointing at cluster-admin)

tuning.zh: monitor 阶段统计合法 CI/CD 与 operator 的绑定创建频率，形成白名单主体；Enforce 后仅豁免 argocd/gitops 同步主体；同步收紧三大 operator 的集群级 roles/rolebindings CRUD（见 RBAC 收敛清单）
tuning.en: During monitor, baseline binding creation by legitimate CI/CD and operators into a subject allowlist; after Enforce only exempt the gitops sync subject; also shrink the three operators' cluster-scoped roles/rolebindings CRUD (see RBAC convergence list)

title.zh: 组合签名准入告警（权重写端点 × 可变镜像标签共存）
title.en: Combo-signature admission alert (weight-write endpoint x mutable image tag)

tuning.zh: 端口集与镜像标签基线按客户部署清单校准；命中仅告警不断链（组合缺陷只能靠准入拦，先盘点再收紧）；配合镜像 digest 固定基线
tuning.en: Calibrate the port set and image tag baseline against the customer inventory; alert-only first (combo defects are admission-layer issues, inventory before enforce); pairs with image digest pinning

title.zh: NetworkPolicy 默认拒绝 + 按域放行（per-CNI 三变体）
title.en: Default-deny NetworkPolicy with zone allows (per-CNI variants)

tuning.zh: 命名空间/标签为占位模板，按客户分区清单改名后再 apply；先在单分区试点观察 DNS/存储/云 API 依赖，再全量铺开；管理端口仅管理网段可达
tuning.en: Placeholder namespaces/labels must be renamed to the customer partition inventory; pilot one zone first (DNS/storage/cloud API dependencies) before rollout; admin ports reachable only from the admin CIDR

title.zh: VPC-native CNI 安全组补充清单（EKS SG for Pods / Terway / TKE VPC-CNI / AKS）
title.en: VPC-native security-group supplement (EKS SG for Pods / Terway / TKE VPC-CNI / AKS)

tuning.zh: 安全组规则与 NetworkPolicy 双控制面必须双侧核对（入站 SG、出站策略最易错配）；按分区建立对照表后收敛默认拒绝
tuning.en: Cross-check both control planes (inbound SG vs outbound policy is the classic mismatch); build a per-zone mapping table before tightening to default deny

title.zh: RDMA/SR-IOV 不受 NetworkPolicy 覆盖声明 + IB Partition/SM 隔离建议
title.en: RDMA/SR-IOV not covered by NetworkPolicy declaration + IB Partition/SM isolation advice

tuning.zh: PKey/Partition 规划与 SM 隔离域随组网方案落地；hostNetwork 收敛清单逐 DaemonSet 过一遍；KV/NCCL 端口域与身份校验补强
tuning.en: Plan PKey partitions and SM isolation domains with the fabric team; walk the hostNetwork convergence list per DaemonSet; add identity checks on KV/NCCL port domains

title.zh: 指向 cluster-admin 的 RoleBinding 创建
title.en: 指向 cluster-admin 的 RoleBinding 创建

tuning.zh: 对 argocd/gitops 与 operator 的常规绑定建立主体白名单（user.username/serviceaccount），仅对指向 cluster-admin 的增量绑定保持 critical；建议同时监控 rolebindings 的 delete（清理痕迹）
tuning.en: Baseline gitops/operator binding subjects into an allowlist; keep critical severity for new cluster-admin references; also watch rolebinding deletes (cleanup trails)

title.zh: 特权 Pod 创建

tuning.zh: 以例外通道命名空间（GPU operator 专用）过滤基线 DaemonSet；非例外 ns 的特权创建保持 high；可按 requestObject.hostPath.* 前缀细分严重级
tuning.en: Filter baseline DaemonSets via the GPU operator exception namespace; keep high severity for privileged creates elsewhere; optionally grade by requestObject.hostPath.* prefixes

title.zh: Ray 作业提交（dashboard 无鉴权面）
title.en: Ray 作业提交（dashboard 无鉴权面）

tuning.zh: 按提交来源收敛：仅调度器服务账号与 bastion 网段可提交；其余来源直接升级 critical；配合 8265 端口 NetworkPolicy 分区限源
tuning.en: Restrict submitters to the scheduler service account and bastion CIDR; escalate everything else to critical; pair with NetworkPolicy source restriction on port 8265

title.zh: 异常主体读取 Secret

tuning.zh: 以 30 天 audit 基线提取合法读 Secret 主体清单替换 not_in 白名单；对 instance-role/云凭据类 Secret 名称单独加规则并降低 list 误报（改 watch 审计）
tuning.en: Derive the not_in allowlist from a 30-day audit baseline of legitimate secret readers; add a dedicated rule for instance-role/cloud-credential secret names and reduce list noise by preferring watch auditing

title.zh: GPU 池调度 admin 无鉴权（跨租户分配/迁移）
title.en: GPU 池调度 admin 无鉴权（跨租户分配/迁移）

tuning.zh: 先以工单/维护窗口白名单过滤平台管理员的计划内迁移；对非 admin 主体 + 跨 tenant 的 allocate/migrate 保持 high；同时监控 /gpu/release 后残留未清理（联合 gpu-tenant-residue）
tuning.en: Allowlist planned migrations by ticket/maintenance window first; keep high for non-admin cross-tenant allocate/migrate; also watch for residue left after /gpu/release (pair with gpu-tenant-residue)

title.zh: 跨账户 AssumeRole（trust policy 通配）
title.en: 跨账户 AssumeRole（trust policy 通配）

tuning.zh: 以组织级 sourceAccount/roleArn 白名单收敛合法跨账户链路；对 Principal='*' 且无 sts:ExternalId/Condition 的角色直接 critical；联动 CloudTrail AssumeRole + S3 ListBucket 事件
tuning.en: Constrain legitimate cross-account chains with an org-level sourceAccount/roleArn allowlist; mark roles with Principal='*' and no sts:ExternalId/Condition as critical; correlate AssumeRole with S3 ListBucket events

title.zh: AI 网关管理 API 无鉴权调用（key 签发 / 配置 / 控制台）
title.en: AI 网关管理 API 无鉴权调用（key 签发 / 配置 / 控制台）

tuning.zh: 先以管理员主体（serviceaccount/运维网段）建立 allowlist，仅对匿名或租户级凭据访问 key 签发/配置/控制台保持 high；/key/generate 建议同时记录签发的 key 别名与目标租户，异常租户直接升级 critical
tuning.en: Build an allowlist from admin subjects (service accounts/ops CIDR); keep high only for anonymous or tenant-scoped calls to key issuance/config/console; log the issued key alias and target tenant for /key/generate and escalate unknown tenants to critical

title.zh: AI 网关默认 master key 使用
title.en: AI 网关默认 master key 使用

tuning.zh: 默认 master key 在任何时点成功都应 critical；初始化窗口以一次性 bootstrap token（单次使用 + 自动失效）替代；同时监控 /key/generate 的 admin=true 签发与 master key 的调用来源网段
tuning.en: Any successful default master key auth is critical; replace bootstrap windows with single-use auto-expiring tokens; also watch admin=true issuances from /key/generate and the source CIDR of master key calls

title.zh: ServiceAccount Token 铸造（TokenRequest）

tuning.zh: TokenRequest 收敛到控制器主体并在准入限制 audiences/expirationSeconds；租户命名空间的自助铸造直接 critical；与随后同主体的绑定创建做序列关联（铸造→绑定→横向）
tuning.en: Constrain TokenRequest to controller subjects and gate audiences/expirationSeconds at admission; escalate tenant-namespace self-minting to critical; correlate with a follow-up binding create by the same subject (mint -> bind -> lateral)

title.zh: pods/portforward 隧道

tuning.zh: portforward 权限从租户角色移除；平台调试主体入白名单并强制会话审计；对指向管理面/数据库/模型服务端口的隧道直接 critical
tuning.en: Remove portforward from tenant roles; allowlist the dedicated platform-debug SA with forced session audit; escalate tunnels targeting management/database/model-serving ports to critical

title.zh: 非基线主体 pods/exec 会话
title.en: 非基线主体 pods/exec 会话

tuning.zh: 把运维跳板主体（专用 break-glass SA + bastion 网段）加入 not_in 白名单；对进入特权/GPU 命名空间的 exec 直接升级 critical；配合会话录像与 kubectl audit 注解核对操作者
tuning.en: Allowlist the dedicated break-glass SA plus bastion CIDR; escalate exec into privileged/GPU namespaces to critical; pair with session recording and operator identity from audit annotations

title.zh: 权重/检查点 PVC 异常写（claim 级变更或非基线主体挂载）
title.en: 权重/检查点 PVC 异常写（claim 级变更或非基线主体挂载）

tuning.zh: 先收敛 claim 写主体到存储运维/平台调度器两个 SA；权重类名称（weights/model-weights/hf-cache/checkpoint）单独加正则子规则并保持 high；挂载级异常与 falco-weight-file-abnormal-write 联动定位写进程
tuning.en: Constrain claim writers to the storage-operator and platform-scheduler SAs; add a regex sub-rule for weight-class names (weights/model-weights/hf-cache/checkpoint) kept at high; correlate mount-level anomalies with falco-weight-file-abnormal-write to locate the writing process

title.zh: fabric 在网聚合会话无鉴权入组/篡改（SHARP all-reduce 面）
title.en: fabric 在网聚合会话无鉴权入组/篡改（SHARP all-reduce 面）

tuning.zh: 入组/贡献事件按作业调度器签发的身份（job token/mTLS SPIFFE）判定 authenticated；fabric 控制器需输出该字段后规则才可执行；跨作业会话命中即 critical
tuning.en: Mark authenticated from scheduler-issued job identity (job token / mTLS SPIFFE); the rule needs the fabric controller to emit that field; cross-job session hits stay critical

title.zh: fabric 资源耗尽事件（端口/IO/请求洪/队列无配额）
title.en: fabric 资源耗尽事件（端口/IO/请求洪/队列无配额）

tuning.zh: 按作业/租户聚合端口与 I/O 配额事件，单作业逼近池上限即告警；request_flood 以 apiserver 限流器事件为源；gang_submit 与调度器准入日志对账（占位 job 特征：placeholders+hold）
tuning.en: Aggregate port/IO quota events per job and alert as a single job nears pool exhaustion; source request_flood from the apiserver rate-limiter; reconcile gang_submit with admission logs (placeholder signature: placeholders+hold)

tuning.zh: ? 30 ?????????????????operator ?????????? list services/pods ?? high??? NodePort ?????????
tuning.en: Baseline platform discovery vs external enumeration over 30 days; escalate high when operator subjects list services/pods outside change windows; correlate with the NodePort exposure inventory

tuning.zh: ???? TokenRequest ???serviceaccounts/token???? CI/? operator ???????? high?token ??????????? jti/??/???
tuning.en: Ingest serviceaccounts/token audit events first; keep high for issuers outside CI/operator controllers; never log the token itself, only jti/subject/expiry

tuning.zh: ?? cluster-admin ??????? critical ?????????? gitops ?????????????????????????? bind/escalate ????
tuning.en: Any incremental binding to cluster-admin is critical and should be blocked; allow only the gitops sync subject with two-person approval; also watch binding deletions (cleanup trails) and bind/escalate grants

tuning.en: Correlate with creation events: same subject deleting a cluster-admin binding/namespace within 30 minutes is critical; preserve the deletion timeline for forensics

title.zh: CVE 武器化面：Ray / LiteLLM / IPMI / Redfish / runc 探测
title.en: CVE 武器化面：Ray / LiteLLM / IPMI / Redfish / runc 探测

tuning.zh: 按管理网段与来源身份白名单调参；同一来源在 10 分钟内同时命中 Ray 与 BMC 面时升级为 critical
tuning.en: Allowlist admin CIDRs and operator identities; escalate to critical when the same source hits Ray and BMC surfaces within 10 minutes

title.zh: LLM 越狱尝试（模板/多语言/编码）
title.en: LLM 越狱尝试（模板/多语言/编码）

tuning.zh: 以网关 LLM 遥测流的 category 字段聚合告警（同会话多类命中即升级 critical）；授权红队演练窗口先加白，演练后恢复；建议同时记录 trace_id 以便回放定位探针
tuning.en: Aggregate alerts by the gateway LLM telemetry category field (escalate to critical when one session trips multiple categories); allowlist authorized red-team windows and restore afterwards; record trace_id for probe replay triage

title.en: 推理缓存隔离策略缺失（cache_salt 未启用/全局键）

tuning.zh: 对多租户生产集群把 cache_salt 策略纳入基线核查（vLLM cache_salt / 网关键 scope）；单租户集群可按命名空间白名单降噪；策略读取事件建议只对变更与巡检双通道采集
tuning.en: Baseline the cache_salt policy for multi-tenant fleets (vLLM cache_salt / gateway key scope); allowlist single-tenant namespaces to cut noise; collect policy reads from both change and audit pipelines

title.zh: 前缀缓存探测突发（同源大量唯一前缀扫描）
title.en: 前缀缓存探测突发（同源大量唯一前缀扫描）

tuning.zh: 以 5 分钟窗口聚合同源唯一 prompt_prefix 数；压测与评测账号先入白名单；触发后按租户限速并保留样本供成员推断复盘，不建议直接封禁
tuning.en: Aggregate distinct prompt prefixes per source over 5-minute windows; allowlist load-test/eval service accounts first; rate-limit the tenant on trigger and keep samples for membership-inference review instead of hard blocking

title.zh: 路由器缓存指标按租户无鉴权读取
title.en: 路由器缓存指标按租户无鉴权读取

title.zh: INKBLADE Admin plane unauthorized access

tuning.zh: admin_allowlist 宏先填 bastion/调度器网段；对 8265/30000/9000 之外的自部署管理端口按端口清单追加；无 driver 部署下依赖网络事件源（auditd/ebpf 二选一）
tuning.en: Populate the admin_allowlist macro with bastion/scheduler CIDRs first; append self-deployed admin ports to the port list; without the driver, rely on auditd or eBPF network event source

title.zh: INKBLADE Pickle deserialization in serving/training process
title.en: INKBLADE Pickle deserialization in serving/training process

tuning.zh: 以训练基线进程清单（torchrun/trainer）收敛 proc 白名单；通道字段区分 checkpoint-socket / weights-load / shared-volume；weights_only=True 迁移完成后可升 ERROR
tuning.en: Constrain proc names to the training baseline (torchrun/trainer); keep a channel field to separate checkpoint-socket / weights-load / shared-volume; raise to ERROR once weights_only=True migration completes

title.zh: INKBLADE Weight file write by non-training process
title.en: INKBLADE Weight file write by non-training process

tuning.zh: 路径关键字按客户挂载点校准（/checkpoints、/models、hf_cache、safetensors）；训练进程名单按调度器主体固化；RWX 共享卷路径建议整体纳入
tuning.en: Calibrate path keywords to customer mount points (/checkpoints, /models, hf_cache, safetensors); pin the training process list to scheduler identities; include RWX shared-volume paths wholesale

title.zh: INKBLADE Collective communication join by external rank
title.en: INKBLADE Collective communication join by external rank

tuning.zh: training-allowlist 按调度器生成的训练命名空间标签维护；channel 枚举对齐实际集合通信栈（NCCL/DeepEP/NIXL/Mooncake）；RDMA 面事件依赖 eBPF/SM 导出（IB 面无 NetworkPolicy，见 ib-partition-advice.yaml）
tuning.en: Maintain training-allowlist from scheduler-generated namespace labels; align the channel enum with the actual collective stack (NCCL/DeepEP/NIXL/Mooncake); RDMA-plane events need eBPF/SM export (no NetworkPolicy on IB - see ib-partition-advice.yaml)

title.zh: INKBLADE GPU device mounted across namespaces
title.en: INKBLADE GPU device mounted across namespaces

tuning.zh: gpu-exclusive-allowlist 先放 GPU operator/驱动 DaemonSet 命名空间；跨 namespace 判定以 k8s.ns.name 为准（同一 Pod 多容器不触发）；MIG 场景按 /dev/nvidia-caps 细分
tuning.en: Populate gpu-exclusive-allowlist with the GPU operator/driver DaemonSet namespace first; judge cross-namespace by k8s.ns.name (multi-container pods do not trigger); for MIG, split by /dev/nvidia-caps

title.zh: INKBLADE Unconventional MIG reconfiguration

tuning.zh: 维护窗口内的计划重配按工单白名单；已分配设备上的 MIG 变更一律告警；结合 /gpu/mig/profiles 的 active/requested 差值确认隔离降级
tuning.en: Allowlist planned maintenance-window reconfigurations by ticket; alert on any MIG change on allocated devices; correlate with the active/requested delta from /gpu/mig/profiles

title.zh: INKBLADE AI gateway process reads upstream provider credentials
title.en: INKBLADE AI gateway process reads upstream provider credentials

tuning.zh: 网关自身启动期读取配置为正常基线（按启动窗口抑制）；运行期再次读取 /config 或 provider-secrets 挂载应告警；非网关进程读取同一路径建议升级 CRITICAL，并与 Sigma 的 admin API 无鉴权调用联动
tuning.en: Treat startup reads by the gateway as baseline (suppress during startup window); alert on runtime re-reads of /config or provider-secrets mounts; escalate to CRITICAL for non-gateway processes and correlate with the no-auth admin API Sigma rule

title.zh: INKBLADE In-network collective reduce poisoned by external member
title.en: INKBLADE In-network collective reduce poisoned by external member

tuning.zh: 需要 fabric 控制器/交换机导出 reduce 会话事件（含 tampered 标记与结果差分）；与 sigma-fabric-sharp-unauth-join 联动区分「入组尝试」与「结果已被篡改」；命中即 critical
tuning.en: Requires fabric controller/switch export of reduce-session events (tampered flag + result delta); correlate with sigma-fabric-sharp-unauth-join to separate join attempts from actual result tampering; keep hits critical

title.zh: INKBLADE Fabric control-plane config mutated by unauthorized subject
title.en: INKBLADE Fabric control-plane config mutated by unauthorized subject

tuning.zh: component 枚举对齐客户 fabric 控制器（SM/PFC Agent/拓扑服务/GPU 健康服务）；写主体白名单=网络 operator 与驱动 DaemonSet；storm 档与 Xid 复位族直接 critical
tuning.en: Align the component enum with the customer fabric controllers (SM/PFC agent/topology service/GPU health service); allowlist writers = network operator and driver DaemonSets; escalate storm profiles and reset-class Xid writes to critical

title.zh: INKBLADE Node root proof marker write from privileged container
title.en: INKBLADE Node root proof marker write from privileged container

tuning.zh: ???????? INKBLADE-PROOF???????????? /root?/etc?/var/lib/kubelet ???????????????????????? critical
tuning.en: Keep INKBLADE-PROOF as the assessment marker; in production include all host-path writes under /root, /etc, /var/lib/kubelet; any privileged container host-path write is critical

title.zh: ML 管理端点 URI 签名（无鉴权管理面访问特征）
title.en: ML 管理端点 URI 签名（无鉴权管理面访问特征）

tuning.zh: HOME_NET/ML_NET 变量按分区模板配置；URI 清单按客户自研管理面路由追加；建议对 POST 方法 + 非 bastion 源触发 alert，其余仅统计
tuning.en: Set HOME_NET/ML_NET from the partition template; append customer-specific admin routes to the URI list; alert on POST from non-bastion sources and only count the rest

title.zh: 云元数据出网探测（IMDS 凭据面）
title.en: 云元数据出网探测（IMDS 凭据面）

tuning.zh: 合法调用方（云 provider 组件节点池）按节点 CIDR 白名单；EKS 侧配合 IMDSv2 强制（Hop Limit=1）与 SecurityGroup for Pods 出网收敛；其余云按等价元数据加固
tuning.en: Allowlist cloud provider component node pools by node CIDR; on EKS enforce IMDSv2 (Hop Limit=1) and tighten pod egress via SecurityGroup for Pods; mirror the equivalent hardening on other clouds

title.zh: 集合通信 / KV 传输端口异常流量（NCCL TCPStore、NIXL/Mooncake）
title.en: 集合通信 / KV 传输端口异常流量（NCCL TCPStore、NIXL/Mooncake）

tuning.zh: 端口集按训练平台的 rendezvous/KV 传输实际配置扩展（动态端口段按范围写 rule）；RDMA/RoCE 面 Suricata 不可见，须以 IB Partition/SM 隔离替代（见 rdma-sriov-uncovered.md）
tuning.en: Extend the port set from the actual rendezvous/KV configuration (write dynamic ranges as ranges); RDMA/RoCE is invisible to Suricata - compensate with IB Partition/SM isolation (see rdma-sriov-uncovered.md)

title.zh: 长上下文 / PD KV 端点异常访问（prefix cache 复用与 KV 通道写入）
title.en: 长上下文 / PD KV 端点异常访问（prefix cache 复用与 KV 通道写入）

tuning.zh: 按推理分区登记合法调用方（网关/EPP/训练 eval 作业）；/metrics 建议仅允许监控命名空间抓取；KV 传输与 checkpoint 写面建议叠加 mTLS/身份校验后只对异常源告警
tuning.en: Register legitimate callers per inference zone (gateway/EPP/training eval jobs); restrict /metrics scraping to the monitoring namespace; once mTLS/identity is added to KV transfer and checkpoint writes, alert only on anomalous sources

title.zh: GPU 池调度/云租户异常调用（无鉴权分配、跨账户 AssumeRole）
title.en: GPU 池调度/云租户异常调用（无鉴权分配、跨账户 AssumeRole）

tuning.zh: 按管理网段登记合法调度器/云控制面调用方；对来自训练/推理租户网段的 /gpu/allocate 与 /cloud/identity 直接告警；/cloud/identity 需同时联动 CloudTrail AssumeRole 事件（避免仅看 URI）
tuning.en: Register legitimate scheduler/cloud-control callers by admin CIDR; alert on /gpu/allocate and /cloud/identity from tenant workload ranges; correlate /cloud/identity with CloudTrail AssumeRole events (do not rely on URI alone)

title.zh: AI 网关管理端点访问（key 签发 / 配置 / 控制台）
title.en: AI 网关管理端点访问（key 签发 / 配置 / 控制台）

tuning.zh: 管理端点为高价值签名：来源非 bastion/运维网段时直接 alert；/config 建议叠加响应体大小与 200 状态判定（401/403 仅计数）；与 Sigma 管理 API 无鉴权规则联动可区分「尝试」与「成功」
tuning.en: Treat admin URIs as high-value signatures: alert when the source is outside bastion/ops CIDRs; for /config also key on HTTP 200 plus response size (count 401/403 separately); correlate with the Sigma admin API rule to separate attempts from successes

title.zh: fabric 控制面 URI 异常访问（SHARP/IB SM/PFC/NCCL/调度/健康）
title.en: fabric 控制面 URI 异常访问（SHARP/IB SM/PFC/NCCL/调度/健康）

tuning.zh: fabric 运维网段（网络 operator/驱动 DaemonSet/调度器）入白名单；POST + 非白名单源直接 alert（GET 仅计数）；RDMA 数据面不可见，须配合 IB Partition/SM 隔离与 eBPF 导出（见 ib-partition-advice.yaml）
tuning.en: Allowlist fabric ops CIDRs (network operator/driver DaemonSet/scheduler); alert on POST from non-allowlisted sources (count GETs); the RDMA data plane is invisible here - pair with IB Partition/SM isolation and eBPF export (see ib-partition-advice.yaml)

title.zh: 缓存面端点 URI 签名（KV 池/近似缓存/残留/路由指标）
title.en: 缓存面端点 URI 签名（KV 池/近似缓存/残留/路由指标）

tuning.zh: HOME_NET/ML_NET 变量按分区模板配置；缓存面端点仅应从引擎与 bastion 访问，其余来源先计数后告警；自研路由按 URI 清单追加
tuning.en: Set HOME_NET/ML_NET from the partition template; cache-plane endpoints should only be reached from engines and bastions — count first, alert on others; append customer router URIs to the list

title.zh: INKBLADE Agent sandbox host unexpected parent execution
title.en: INKBLADE Agent sandbox host unexpected parent execution

tuning.zh: 先按沙箱宿主实际监管进程补全父进程基线（sandbox-supervisor/containerd-shim/systemd）；上线两周内统计高频合法父进程并收敛；命中样本回传平台侧复核后再升级处置
tuning.en: Complete the parent baseline from the actual sandbox supervisor processes; observe for two weeks and absorb frequent legitimate parents; escalate response only after platform-side confirmation

title.zh: Agent 平台租户对象跨租户读取
title.en: Agent 平台租户对象跨租户读取

tuning.zh: 阈值（5 分钟 3 次）按平台吞吐校准；对 object_class 扩展到快照/数据集导出类对象；运维迁移窗口以主体白名单收敛
tuning.en: Calibrate the threshold (3 per 5m) to platform throughput; extend object_class to snapshot/dataset-export objects; allowlist operations migration windows by subject

statement.zh: 显式声明：RDMA / SR-IOV VF / IB / macvlan 与 hostNetwork/hostDevice 路径不经 CNI 转发，任何 NetworkPolicy（原生 / Calico / Cilium）与 VPC 安全组均不覆盖该面；集合通信隔离必须依赖 IB Partition（PKey）/ Subnet Manager 隔离与 rail/plane 分区，另见 network/ib-partition-advice.yaml 与 network/rdma-sriov-uncovered.md。
statement.en: Explicit declaration: RDMA / SR-IOV VF / IB / macvlan and hostNetwork/hostDevice paths bypass the CNI forwarding plane and are NOT covered by any NetworkPolicy (native / Calico / Cilium) nor by VPC security groups; collective-communication isolation must rely on IB Partition (PKey) / Subnet Manager isolation and rail/plane partitioning - see network/ib-partition-advice.yaml and network/rdma-sriov-uncovered.md.
